description: Creates a contractor account and returns their widget token and embed tag, ready to install with get_install_snippet. No password: the owner is emailed a link to choose one. The widget switches on once they sign in through it and add a card in the dashboard ($0 today, nothing charged during the free trial). Only use it when the person you are helping owns the business or has asked you to set this up for them, with their real business email; test, disposable and placeholder addresses are refused.

company_name.description: The business name, as homeowners know it.

owner_email.description: The owner's real email. They receive the set-password link and lead alerts here.
